Commission plans with a 15 ETH cap

About PSA

What we are promoting

Pink Sheet Apes is a licensed security NFT. Each NFT holds a million tokens, and the NFT is how someone buys the token. The mint price steps up with each mint. A solvency script routes a percent of each sale into a payment contract. Staking locks the NFT.

This page does not claim a token price, a mint price, or a return.

The Steppas network

Steppas is a coordinated crypto native KOL network run by @0xZango. The pages post, and every active page is tracked in our analytics app, Big Step Track.

Payment terms

  • $7,000 due on signing, before launch. Rail to agree: USDC, ETH, or wire.
  • $7,000 more when 50 percent of PSA's total NFT supply is minted (supply TBD). Paid within 7 days of the milestone. Phase 2 starts within 7 days of payment and repeats the signed scope.
  • Affiliate cut on top: the fixed percent already in PSA's payment contract (commission % TBD), on sales attributed to Steppas or ambassador codes.
  • Giveaway SOL and mint budgets are funded by PSA in advance and sit outside both fees.
Separate from the fees

Ambassador program

15 ETH pool

Set aside by PSA. It caps ambassador commissions. When credited commissions reach 15 ETH, new codes pause until PSA adds funds.

Commission % TBD

The fixed percent already routed from the solvency script into the payment contract, on each attributed sale. Early mints pay fewer dollars and later mints pay more, because the mint price steps up.

About $50 mint stipend

Per ambassador, paid by PSA, separate from the 15 ETH. First wave: Fiji, Cloud, Angel, Trip, Smoke, Zango and Shy if they opt in. $350 for all seven.

  • One code or link per ambassador in the payment contract. PSA shares a view only access. Steppas reconciles it in the Monday report.
  • Every ambassador post says "PSA ambassador" and #ad. The structure needs sign off from PSA's counsel.
Funded by PSA, on top of the fee

Giveaways and sponsored mints

Real SOL giveaways

1 to 3 SOL per page that runs one, sent before the post goes up. Phase 1 pages that can run one: Fiji, Cloud, Angel, Smoke and Zango. Each post states the amount, how to enter, the end time with timezone, one winner, and that PSA funded it. Winner picked in public.

Watched wallet mints

Shy, Cloud and Smoke mint PSA on the wallets people watch, with a mint budget from PSA (amount open). Any post or Space that shows the mint says the budget came from PSA and includes #ad. Tracked separately from attributed mints.
